scope: Trusted harness cold evidence after source unwind only. No producer/source/owner authority is minted.
records: Every existing registry._calls row in canonical ordinal order, including reserved and uninvoked. No absent row is invented and no inactive preallocated slot is called a reservation.

atoms.BOOL: Exact builtin bool retained as {tag:BOOL,value:bool}; does not become integer zero.
atoms.INT: Exact builtin integer in [-2^63,2^64) retained as {tag:INT,value:integer}, including zero and negative BOOL32.
atoms.FLOAT64_BITS: Exact builtin float as {tag:FLOAT64_BITS,bits:16 lowercase hex digits from little-endian pack}; retains signed zero/NaN bits if present without JSON nonfinite coercion.
atoms.TEXT: Exact builtin string of at most 256 code points, retained as TEXT/value with ensure_ascii encoding.
atoms.BYTES: Exact builtin bytes of at most 256 bytes, retained as BYTES/hex. No bulk buffer value is copied.
atoms.OBSERVED_UNENCODABLE: Other original object or oversized raw value is explicitly observed with bounded type name/local object ID, unknown raw value, and no positive result. Local ID is diagnostic only. No supplied str/repr/conversion is called.

queries.policy: Stream the actual already-captured immutable c.query_bytes values in canonical call order. Null means unobserved with null offset/size/hash. Known empty bytes remains observed length zero. No pool assembly, query hex or borrowed mutable-buffer reconstruction. Each row carries its exact sequential offset/length/hash.

spy_completion_flags.2: scalar hook completed; NOT authoritative first-assignment observedness
spy_completion_flags.4: count hook completed; NOT authoritative first-assignment observedness
spy_completion_flags.8: normal Python return prepared; NOT caller receipt

raw_authority: Canonical raw atoms derive only from direct sentinel/original slot values. Store hooks can first-assign and later raise; their completion bits never replace these facts. Hash/copy raw None returns are observed NULL, distinct from UNOBSERVED.
stored_fields: read_fold.contribution and hash/copy.stored_count_field retain their actual source slot/cache values without repairing them. The hash/copy field is not independently declared byte work; raw observed helper returns plus the actual defined scalar/count facts and canonical terminal totals establish known byte contributions.
close_counts: The spy count records scripted close attempts. The proof labels actual_close_attempts separately from canonical_known_successful_close_returns (invoked CloseHandle with observed strict signed32 nonzero scalar). A known scalar success remains distinct from unknown wrapper return or consumed right.
partial_counts: Read dispatch attempts, helper-completed read deliveries and helper-completed delivery bytes are separately labelled. Actual source canonical counts remain in first_actual_terminal and the raw sidecar. The binary log records the actual canonical ordinal, which may exceed its dispatch index after an uninvoked failed reservation; known-failed-prefix legal cleanup remains permitted without relaxing positive ordinal checks.
memory: At most one <=4096B encoded row and one row dictionary plus references to existing immutable query bytes. No full call-dict list, producer method, clock sample, re-freeze, new owner or bulk buffer copy.
failure: Progress records expected/written rows, bytes and explicit unknown/unencodable counts. A failed writer leaves first exclusive partial artifacts and vetoes PASS; no retry or overwrite.
